test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: NEP 2020 recommends to establish which of the following institutes/organisations to accelerate the research and innovation in India?

options.text: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research
Mahatma Gandhi International Institute for Research in India
National Foundation for Innovation and Research in India.

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Research Foundation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The overarching goal of the NRF will be to enable a culture of research to permeate through our universities
 
• The NRF will competitively fund research in all disciplines. Successful research will be recognized, and where relevant, implemented through close linkages with governmental agencies as well as with industry and private/philanthropic organizations.
 
• The NRF will provide a reliable base of merit-based but equitable peer-reviewed research funding, helping to develop a culture of research in the country through suitable incentives for and recognition of outstanding research, and by undertaking major initiatives to seed and grow research at State Universities and other public institutions where research capability is currently limited.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The NEP 2020 highlights the importance of play-based and activity-based learning for young children in the early stages of education.
 
• It encourages a more holistic and developmentally appropriate approach to early childhood education, focusing on active and experiential learning through play and various engaging activities.
 
• This approach is seen as crucial for fostering creativity, critical thinking, and overall cognitive development in young learners, moving away from traditional rote memorization techniques.
 
• The NEP 2020 also emphasizes the significance of a flexible and multidisciplinary curriculum that takes into account the diverse needs and interests of children in their early years of education.
